title: INT8/FP16 embedding quantization calibration and cosine-similarity drift audit
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Objective: create reproducible INT8 and FP16 quantization profiles for our embedding models, formalize a calibration workflow, and build a cosine-similarity drift audit (offline + automated) to ensure client vector quality does not regress after quantization or during model rollouts. This ticket centralizes the calibration recipe, evaluation thresholds, test harness, and monitoring hooks required for release in runtime-1.22.

Background: past experiments showed small but actionable cosine similarity shifts for some customer workloads after aggressive quantization. We need a deterministic calibration and validation pipeline that: (1) yields quant profiles for INT8/FP16 that preserve embedding utility, (2) documents per-model tolerance levels, and (3) provides automated drift detection and alerting integrated into the Console.

Scope: embedding models used for similarity search and retrieval. Not addressing decoder generation quality. Work includes dataset selection, calibration tooling, quant profile generation, offline evaluation (cosine metrics and downstream retrieval A/B tests), unit/CI tests, and a Console alert for weekly drift checks.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration script (redwood-quant calibrate) produces stable per-layer INT8 and FP16 profiles from a specified calibration corpus
Automated evaluation job computes baseline and post-quant cosine similarity distributions and compares metrics per-model; results stored in metrics-store and visible in Console
Defined thresholds: mean cosine delta (baseline -> quant) < 0.002; 99th percentile drop < 0.01; retrieval NDCG@10 relative degradation < 0.5% for production retrieval tests
CI checks that run on PRs fail if cosine mean shift > 0.003 or any tested customer corpus shows > 1.5% NDCG drop
Documentation: calibration recipe + how to add a new model to the pipeline committed in docs/quantization/ and linked in Console
Rollback policy and canary plan documented for Dedicated/Private rollouts
tasks: Assemble representative calibration datasets (50k-100k vectors) for each model variant and store in s3://redwood-quant/calibration/<model>/
Implement redwood-quant CLI -- calibrate, profile, and validate subcommands
Add CI unit tests that run fast sanity checks (1k vectors) and a nightly full-suite job (50k vectors)
Compute and persist baseline embeddings for each calibration corpus and model commit SHA
Implement cosine-drift auditor job that produces time-series metrics and alerts to PagerDuty/Console
Create Console dashboard panels for mean delta, p50/p95/p99 deltas, and retrieval regression summaries
Document thresholds and onboarding steps for adding new models to the audit
calibration_plan: 1) Data: select ~50k representative queries per model from anonymized customer corpora + public corpora (MS MARCO, Natural Questions). 2) Preprocessing: apply same tokenization and truncation used at inference. 3) Run calibration: redwood-quant calibrate --model <model> --dtype int8 --calibration-s3 s3://redwood-quant/calibration/<model>/ --out-profile profiles/<model>-int8.json --batch-size 1024 --collect-activations. Repeat for --dtype fp16. 4) Profile format: per-layer min/max, histogram/sketch, per-channel scale factors where applicable, and recommended runtime flags (enable-per-channel, symmetric/asymmetric). 5) Store artifacts: profiles, activation histograms, and summary report in artifacts/quant/<model>/<sha>/
test_plan: Offline metrics: compute cosine similarity between float32 baseline and quantized embeddings for calibration corpus; report mean, std, p50/p95/p99 deltas, and fraction below thresholds
Downstream evaluation: run retrieval NDCG@k and recall@k on canonical evaluation splits (NDCG target: <0.5% relative regression for production models)
A/B simulation: synthetic routing to model-variant with simulated traffic to validate latency and metric stability
Unit tests: small synthetic inputs that assert deterministic profile outputs and reproducible embedding deltas
CI integration: quick-run smoke test as part of PRs (1k vectors), nightly full-run job (50k vectors) that posts results to metrics-store
rollout_plan: 1) Canary (internal-only): deploy quantized model variant to 0.5% internal traffic and run retrieval/metric hooks for 24h. 2) Expanded canary: 5% for 48h if no regressions. 3) Gradual rollout: 20% -> 50% -> 100% with health gates (cosine delta and NDCG). 4) Automatic rollback if any monitored customer corpus exceeds configured thresholds or if Console alert triggers. 5) For Dedicated/Private customers, provide opt-in flag and per-customer canary window before auto-upgrade.
monitoring: Metrics to surface: mean_cosine_delta, p50_delta, p95_delta, p99_delta, fraction_below_threshold
Alert rule: fire if mean_cosine_delta > 0.003 for 6-hour window OR any customer corpus reports NDCG drop > 1%
Dashboard: per-model time series, per-corpus breakdown, and recent calibration artifact links
Retention: keep weekly full-run history for 90 days; keep artifacts for 1 year
